name: PubTables-1M: Towards Comprehensive Table Extraction From Unstructured Documents
description: PubTables-1M is a large-scale benchmark for comprehensive table extraction from unstructured scientific documents. Containing nearly one million annotated tables from PubMed Central articles, it provides complete annotations for table detection, table structure recognition, and functional analysis. It addresses previous limitations in automated table parsing by enforcing rigorous ground-truth consistency and structural cell topology.
